current._comment_cfg_name: this is the name of the variable that is written in the config for the backend
current._comment_type: continuous for continous parameter, that should be included in the bayesian optimization, set to null to exclude from bayesian optimization
current._comment_min: minimum value of the parameter in the bayesian optimization, min and max have no influenze if type is set to null
current._comment_max: maximum value of the parameter in the bayesian optimization
current._comment_convert: converter function to convert the parameter to the backend format, if not needed, set to null
current._comment_limiting_reagent: if this parameter is a limiting reagent, set to true, this will be used to calculate the limiting reagent
current._comment_excluded_from_BO: exclude this parameter from the bayesian optimization
